recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce duplicate core extension definitions; no Extension Pack follow-up is needed for the value type list unless a later work-group decision changes Questionnaire.item's supported answer types.
issue_request: FHIR-27914 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested alignment of the Questionnaire.item minValue and maxValue extension value types by adding Quantity to both and removing instant from maxValue, without adding positiveInt, unsignedInt, instant, or integer64 because Questionnaire.item does not support those types.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 115e85b1ea5092108ce55660e7bec5e6772145df, merged by PR #1328, applied the change in source/profiles/element-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. It changed minValue from date|dateTime|time|decimal|integer to date|dateTime|time|decimal|integer|Quantity and changed maxValue from date|dateTime|time|instant|decimal|integer to date|dateTime|time|decimal|integer|Quantity.
additional_context: FHIR-14016 had previously removed instant from minValue because Questionnaire.item does not allow instant. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-11-16 confirm the FHIR-27914 vote and scope. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the R5 extension definitions from core, and the current definitions live in the FHIR Extension Pack checkout. FHIR-32524 was merged in the same PR but concerns unrelated Questionnaire enableWhen wording and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current Extension Pack source files input/definitions/Questionnaire/StructureDefinition-minValue.xml and StructureDefinition-maxValue.xml both list date, dateTime, time, decimal, integer, and Quantity for Extension.value[x], with no instant, positiveInt, unsignedInt, or integer64. The active core element-extensions spreadsheet has no minValue/maxValue rows to edit.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published decision that removed instant from minValue because Questionnaire.item does not allow instant.
